_meta.description: Per-arm Pearson correlation matrices on experiment.pulse (GROUP_CATEGORY on treatment, one MAT_CORRELATION result per arm) decorated with an OVERLAY_MATRIX_GROUP_SUMMARY overlay on the MATRIX_RESULT host: ref.matrix names the spec, and the primary matrix is each cell's unweighted mean across the arms, with parts min, max, range and n_groups. Keys are the union of the arms' keys; a null cell is skipped. The matrix results are not changed.
_meta.name: matrix-group-summary
